_accepted_risks.what: Pre-remediation PTSleeveStrategy.completeInbound books retFace6 but does NOT consume inFlight6 (zeroing it is a separate keeper ackArrival). A forgotten/failed ack leaves a returned inbound counted TWICE (idle cash AND still-'in-flight') -> totalAssets() reports up to 2x the real money (false-HIGH book that masks a shortfall). R-1 (un-swept realized yield bridgeable back to the venue) is also unfixed live. Source: docs/PT_SLEEVE_REMEDIATION_2026-10-05.md (F-1 HIGH, 'remains LIVE until redeployed'); bytecode sweep t_edbb5fb7.
_accepted_risks.loss_bound_2026-10-10: Per-lane overstatement = the un-acked inbound amount, bounded by that lane's outstanding sent face; reported totalAssets() can reach up to 2x real for that lane. Measured live 2026-10-10 (t_c6e22ed9): PT-Arb 0x2D3E5bf1 = $0 (lane flat, fully unwound 2026-10-09; inFlight6=0, arbValue6=0, totalAssets=0); PT-ETH 0xA96D0BB2 = up to $18.953737 (sent face; arbValue6 $18.959029, inFlight6=0 -> no active phantom) -> vault book $126.269032 could be overstated by up to ~$18.95 (+15%) in the worst case. NOT a direct money loss: it is a book overstatement realizable only by overpaying a withdrawing depositor.

expected_ipfs._doc: Build-currency pins (PY-SCOPE-02, card t_5c5b9f05). Checked by scripts/build_currency_gate.js: eth_getCode -> trailing CBOR metadata -> ipfs multihash, compared to expected_ipfs. expected_ipfs = the build this contract is SUPPOSED to run (a reproducible build of the reviewed source, in the compile profile its deploy lineage uses). known_drift = a live build that is KNOWN to differ and is tracked by the named card; it is reported as KNOWN-DRIFT with BOTH hashes, never as PASS. scope:'inactive' = deployed but not registered / not gating money. No pin = UNPINNED (currency unverifiable). known_unpinned = {contract: {card, reason}}: the ONLY way an unpinned live contract may be non-fatal (reported KNOWN-UNPINNED, loud, with the live ipfs) — any unpinned live contract NOT listed still exits 3, and a vacuous or undisclosed entry FAILs (card t_57742b2e). The gate never rewrites this file: a mismatch is a finding, not a fix. Selector diffs are NOT a currency test (MorphoStrategy scores 0 missing while carrying PY-RECALL-01). known_drift MUST name a build that is declared in builds{} (card t_10b79b12) — a drift whose build cannot be identified or reproduced is a FAIL, not a disclosure; and an exemption's card id MUST resolve to an OPEN card on the kanban board (the sentinel cross-checks it every 10 min, the gate only format-checks it).
